purpose.summary: Extend the legacy-only compatibility matrix with bounded restart and reconstruction checks without changing node behavior or consensus.
scope: Exercise same-datadir clean restart, full -reindex, and chainstate-only -reindex-chainstate on both baseline and candidate roles.
Require fresh daemon lifecycle markers, exact chain, UTXO commitment and raw-tip restoration, and post-rebuild mining by each role.
exclusions: No production-node, consensus, activation, native-asset, optional-indexing, testnet, or mainnet-parameter change.
No pruning, corrupt storage, interrupted reconstruction, crash recovery, deep reorganization, historical-chain, sustained-operation, public-network, or mainnet claim.
No private source, history, operator material, host metadata, binary, or incoming evidence.

exclusions: Private history, operator material, host metadata, and unrelated private product material are excluded.

files.test_reachability: Documents the governed restart and reconstruction lifecycle contract.
Exercises honest two-node coexistence, clean restart, full reindex, and chainstate reindex.
Runs the identity-bound fail-closed public matrix and requires both reconstruction lifecycle markers.
Covers runner contracts, reconstruction lifecycle canaries, record binding, and fail-closed paths.

commands: Configure and build the exact Bitcoin Static v24.0.5 public baseline with the reviewed dependency profile.
expected_results: The baseline daemon is bound to the exact baseline commit, tree, build profile, and binary digest.

commands: Configure and build the exact direct-child public change with the same reviewed dependency profile.
expected_results: The candidate daemon is bound to the reviewed commit, tree, build profile, and binary digest.

scenarios.command: Run the governed two-node legacy/candidate coexistence, restart, and reconstruction scenario.
expected_results: Alternating mining and clean same-datadir restart preserve exact chain, UTXO commitment, and raw-tip projections.
Full reindex and chainstate-only reindex on both roles emit fresh lifecycle markers, restore the exact pre-rebuild snapshot, and accept one new block mined by each role.
failure_conditions: Any process, lifecycle-marker, chain, UTXO, raw-tip, post-rebuild mining, cleanup, or identity divergence fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the corrected zero-subsidy mining fixture with the baseline daemon.
expected_results: The inherited mining fixture passes without skip under the exact baseline role.
failure_conditions: Any skip, timeout, nonzero exit, identity mismatch, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the corrected zero-subsidy mining fixture with the candidate daemon.
expected_results: The inherited mining fixture passes without skip under the exact candidate role.
failure_conditions: Any skip, timeout, nonzero exit, identity mismatch, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the unchanged inherited feature_abortnode.py selection through its default node-launch path.
expected_results: The inherited default-launch scenario passes with byte-equivalent selection.
failure_conditions: Any inherited-selection drift, skip, timeout, nonzero exit, or cleanup failure fails closed.

platforms: Ubuntu 22.04 arm64 with the reviewed public dependency profile
macOS arm64 local contradiction testing only

limitations: This change exercises only a bounded short regtest chain and clean shutdowns.
Fresh log markers establish presence after the current restart offset; state restoration and post-rebuild mining bind the observable effect but do not prove every internal reconstruction path.
Pruning, corrupt storage, interrupted reconstruction, crash recovery, deep reorganization, historical-chain replay, sustained operation, public-network peers, and mainnet remain untested.
Binary digests and config.ini source/build bindings do not prove build causality, and the dependency profile is not locked.
Operator-binary equivalence and mainnet coexistence remain unproved.
If origin/main advances before reconstruction, the parent and all controlled preimages must be reviewed again instead of rebasing silently.
counterevidence: ERGON-CHANGE-0004 public evidence passed its four declared scenarios but did not exercise full reindex or chainstate reindex.
The local pre-binding prototype run and self-tests are excluded from public evidence and cannot promote this change.

The prior public parent 56a18f3bd78e34e78caa7946dc7e1c0a45e8e6b2 was produced by GitHub squash and did not preserve the reviewed SSH commit identity; the SSH-signed policy anchor 17e9dc9792509b7426196b66762556d5efa4ddf5 resolves that publication-workflow blocker without supplying compatibility evidence.
